subject: Request: short technical triage before full demo - Storefront AI
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@storefront.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick tech triage before demo?

Hi Tessa,

I signed up for Redwood last week (trial tenant: storefront-test). We're evaluating inference runtimes for serving our recommendation model and would like a very short technical triage (15 minutes) before committing to a full product demo. We want to validate:
- Network/VPC options and ingress egress controls
- Model size/quantization compatibility (we run a 13B transformer)
- Any obvious integration blockers for our prefix-caching approach

Ideal window this week: Tue/Wed between 10:00–14:00 PT. If possible we'd like a hands-on engineer on the call to confirm whether a private deployment is necessary for our use case.

Attaching a one-page architecture snapshot.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of ML, Storefront AI
samira@storefront.ai
Attachment: storefront-arch.png (image, 1 page)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@storefront.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick tech triage before demo?

Hi Samira — thanks for the note and the diagram, that’s helpful. Happy to set up a short technical triage this week. Monica is our solutions engineer and will be the best person to walk through model/quant details; Ben is cc’d to help coordinate calendar logistics.

A couple quick questions so we make the 15 minutes productive:
- Confirm: the 13B transformer is PyTorch/transformers-based? Any custom kernels?
- Do you have a preference for Hosted vs Private for this initial evaluation? If unsure, Monica can outline tradeoffs in the triage.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed May 12 — 11:00–11:15
- Wed May 12 — 13:00–13:15

If neither works you can pick a time here: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/tessa-15min. Please include any additional security contacts if they need to join.

If you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda (what to expect, prep).

Best,
Tessa Morgan
SDR, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.com
From: Samira Khan <samira@storefront.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick tech triage before demo?

Thanks Tessa — yes, confirmed: model is PyTorch with HuggingFace transformers and a few custom CUDA ops (we can list those if helpful). Hosted is fine for the triage, but our security lead might ask follow-up Qs about private deployments and ingress controls.

I can do 11:00–11:15 PT today. If Monica can cover quantization and KV cache considerations in that window that’d be perfect.
